top10.introHtml: Refreshed 2026-08-28. Cars.com: 26 total, 17 after filters. CarGurus: 78 total, 15 captured (page 1 of search). AutoTrader: 38 total, 13 after filters (Ford Thunderbird 2002 excluded as 2-seater per model knowledge). All sources had >80% image coverage. Top picks weighted by reliable model family, documented condition, manual transmission preference, and proximity to Media, PA.

picks.whyGood: Twin-turbo N55 inline-6 335i convertible with a 6-speed manual and only 60k miles — exceptionally rare in this price band. 2013 is the last E93 year, after all major N54/N55 early-production issues were resolved. CarGurus Great Price badge confirms underpricing.
picks.whatToVerify: Full soft-top cycle (raise/lower); headliner and carpet water staining (rear footwells); rear-window plastic zip seam. Under hood: N55 boost-pipe cracks, oil-filter-housing gasket, coolant expansion tank. Clutch: engagement point (high bite = worn clutch), throw-out bearing chirp, 2nd/3rd synchro slow-shift test. Clutch hydraulics for weep.
picks.bottomLine: Best manual convertible in the region at this price — a true driver's car.

picks.whyGood: Manual S550 Mustang convertible 1 mile away. The 2.3T EcoBoost makes 310 hp with proven reliability. S550 has an independent rear suspension — far better than the S197 live axle. Modern tech (CarPlay, digital gauges). Local dealer makes inspection trivial.
picks.whatToVerify: Full top cycle — S550 tops can leak at rear corners; check headliner and rear seat for water staining. MT-82 shifter: notchy is normal, grinding = synchro wear. Clutch hydraulics for weep. Rear-camera function. EcoBoost oil change history. 8.8 rear axle clunk on takeoff.
picks.bottomLine: The closest manual drop-top on the list — a modern Mustang a mile from home.

picks.whyGood: Newest Mustang in budget with a CarGurus Great Price badge. 2020 brings updated interior, standard CarPlay, and revised suspension tune. Fred Beans is a large reputable PA franchise dealer with good pre-sale standards.
picks.whatToVerify: Top seal at rear corners and B-pillar. Rear seat water staining. 10R80 auto: shudder on light throttle (known — TSB fluid service fixes it). EcoBoost oil service history. Rear 8.8 axle noise.
picks.bottomLine: Most modern Mustang convertible in budget at a dealer with a solid regional reputation.

picks.whyGood: V8 Mustang GT for fun-to-drive priority. The 5.0 Coyote (2011+) is a vast upgrade over the 4.6 3-valve — rev-happy, durable, zero cam-phaser issues. Sold at a Cadillac franchise dealership in Broomall — high certification bar. Reasonable price for a Coyote GT convertible.
picks.whatToVerify: S197 top latch condition (worn latches = wind noise and leaks). Spring perch rust at strut towers. 8.8 axle clunk. Brake rotor condition. Confirm V8 GT — check door sticker and 5.0 badge.
picks.bottomLine: The V8 pick: Coyote grunt at a local franchise dealer.

picks.whyGood: Modern F33 4 Series with xDrive AWD — useful in shoulder seasons. CarGurus Great Price badge. The 2.0T N20 is reliable with proper oil changes. At $9,900 this is genuinely cheap for a 2015 BMW convertible.
picks.whatToVerify: Full soft-top cycle; rear-window zip seam. N20 timing chain tensioner (cold-start rattle = red flag). Oil-filter-housing gasket weep. Valve-cover gasket. xDrive transfer case fluid service. Soft-top hydraulic rams (all 4 — slow movement = pending failure).
picks.bottomLine: A real deal on a modern BMW drop-top if the top hydraulics check out.

picks.whyGood: The 435i's N55 3.0T straight-six is stronger and more linear than the 428i's 2.0T. At $8,500 this is the cheapest performance BMW convertible on the list. xDrive AWD is a bonus. Private party through AT's platform.
picks.whatToVerify: 140k miles demands harder inspection: top hydraulic rams, N55 HPFP, oil leaks (valve cover, oil-filter housing), cooling system (water pump, thermostat). Full top cycle. Budget for upcoming maintenance items.
picks.bottomLine: Best dollar-per-horsepower on the list — worth the extra inspection diligence.

picks.whyGood: Supercharged 3.0 TFSI V6 (333 hp) B8 S5 Cabriolet with only 69k miles — well below average for age. The supercharger is very robust; no turbo lag. The electrically-powered B8 Cabriolet top is smooth and well-reviewed. Genuinely exotic feel for this money.
picks.whatToVerify: Timing chain tensioner (cold-start rattle on early B8 3.0 TFSI). Carbon buildup on intake valves (direct injection — walnut blast). Soft-top motor and all 4 clamps; rear window seam. Quattro/Haldex rear diff fluid service. Confirm S tronic or manual; check for low-speed shudder (DSG fluid issue).
picks.bottomLine: The hidden gem: supercharged S5 Cabriolet with genuinely low miles.

picks.whyGood: Most elegant-looking car on this list. At 65k miles it's the lowest-mileage non-BMW convertible in the search. 2 miles from Media. The 3.5L V6 is smooth and reliable. No mileage red flags.
picks.whatToVerify: Soft-top hydraulic cylinders (W209 common failure; budget $400-800 if they leak). Top fabric and rear-window plastic condition. Oil leaks at valve covers. Rocker panel and sill rust check. No air suspension on W209 CLK to worry about.
picks.bottomLine: The stylish low-mileage pick right in your backyard.

picks.whyGood: The IS 250C's retractable hardtop is unique at this price — quieter than soft-tops, no fabric to rot, and keeps interior temps down. Lexus reliability is class-leading. The 2.5L V6 is bulletproof.
picks.whatToVerify: Full hardtop cycle (all 3 folding sections must move smoothly — hydraulic service is expensive). Error codes during cycle. Trunk seal and rear firewall for water intrusion. Rear seat leather for damp smell. Roof motors: hesitation = early warning.
picks.bottomLine: The most weather-proof convertible experience on this list — hardtop ownership without hardtop price.

picks.whyGood: Newest daily-driveable luxury convertible at a sensible price. Sold by an Audi franchise dealer 10 miles from Media. Quattro AWD useful in wet weather. Reasonable miles for a 2017.
picks.whatToVerify: Soft-top: full cycle, fabric condition, rear window. 2.0T carbon buildup (walnut blast due). DSG: low-speed shudder (DSG fluid service — cheap fix). Any open NHTSA airbag recalls.
picks.bottomLine: The newest, most refined everyday convertible — bought from a brand dealer 10 miles out.

manual10.introHtml: Only 2 confirmed manual-transmission convertibles surfaced across all three sources this refresh. Manual convertibles in the $7k–$15k range near Media, PA are very scarce.

picks.whyGood: Twin-turbo inline-6 with a 6-speed manual, 60k miles, Great Price badge. The definitive manual BMW convertible in this search — the last E93, no cam-phaser headaches, sorted chassis.
picks.whatToVerify: Clutch engagement point (high = worn; should bite in lower third of travel). 2nd/3rd synchro slow-shift at temp. Throw-out bearing chirp at idle clutch-released. Hydraulic clutch master/slave for leaks. Soft-top full cycle; rear-window seam. N55 turbos: boost pipes, HPFP, valve cover, oil-filter housing.
picks.bottomLine: The definitive manual convertible in this search — low miles, twin-turbo, sorted chassis.

picks.whyGood: S550 Mustang convertible with a manual, only 1 mile away. Modern IRS rear end, EcoBoost reliability, CarPlay standard. The MT-82 is notchy but durable. Local = easy return visits.
picks.whatToVerify: Clutch engagement point and pedal feel. MT-82 2nd-gear synchro. Top seal and rear-corner leaks. 8.8 axle clunk. EcoBoost oil change history.
picks.bottomLine: A manual Mustang drop-top you can walk to from Media.

mustangs.introHtml: 3 Ford Mustang convertibles (2005+ per filter) found. One manual (2017 EcoBoost), one modern automatic (2020 EcoBoost), one V8 GT (2012 Coyote). Pre-2005 Mustangs (1987, 1994) appeared on Cars.com and were correctly excluded.

picks.whyGood: Manual 2017 S550 Mustang convertible 1 mile away. Modern IRS, updated interior with CarPlay, proven EcoBoost. The only manual Mustang convertible in the local search.
picks.whatToVerify: MT-82 2nd-gear synchro, clutch hydraulics, top rear-corner seals, EcoBoost oil history, 8.8 axle.
picks.bottomLine: Closest Mustang convertible with a row-it-yourself gearbox — literally in town.

picks.whyGood: Newest Mustang in budget at the lowest price among 2017+ cars. CarGurus Great Price. Fred Beans is a large PA franchise dealer with solid pre-sale standards. 2020 adds revised styling, digital cluster, and standard CarPlay.
picks.whatToVerify: Top seals, 10R80 auto shudder (TSB fluid), EcoBoost oil history, rear 8.8 axle.
picks.bottomLine: Best value modern Mustang convertible at a reputable dealer.

picks.whyGood: Only V8 GT in the budget search. Coyote 5.0 (2011+) is a modern, capable engine — huge upgrade over 4.6 3-valve. Sold at a Cadillac franchise in Broomall. 117k miles is reasonable for a Coyote.
picks.whatToVerify: S197 top latches and seals; spring perch rust at strut towers; 8.8 axle clunk; brake rotors; confirm 5.0 GT.
picks.bottomLine: The V8 choice — Coyote grunt at a local franchise dealer.
